purpose: The deployment-bound human-doctor directory this application consumes. A doctor is a person; employment is a separate affiliation to a healthcare organization, so one clinician can be full-time at a hospital and part-time at a community clinic, and the family can choose which site to consult. The roster is operator content, not product data. A deployment binds the document URL in the public runtime document; when it is absent or unreachable the authored fallback roster answers and the UI says so.

document.transport: HTTP GET, same-origin or an allow-listed deployed origin; no credentials are sent
document.legacyShape: A doctor that still carries flat `hospital` / `department` / `title` / `channels` / `availability` fields is migrated into one primary affiliation with employmentType full_time, so an older deployment document never loses its doctors.

organizationModel.employingOrganization: organizationId — the Appbase organization unit that employs or contracts the clinician. This is the IAM/org scope, and it owns departments, staff roles, and permission scope.
organizationModel.hospital: hospitalCode — the Appbase med_hospital natural key (hospital_code). The hospital directory, grade, ownership, and department catalog are Appbase medical reference data (med_hospital, med_department), not sdkwork-company records.
organizationModel.company: Not the clinical employer. sdkwork-company is the enterprise/recruitment center with its own permissions (company.profiles.*). An affiliation MAY carry `companyId` only for the commercial contract that sits beside the clinical relationship.
organizationModel.rule: Clinical employment is organization + hospital reference data. Never encode a clinician's employment in the doctor id, and never model a hospital as a company.

doctorProfile.id: string, stable person id across deployments and organizations
doctorProfile.avatarUrl: string; the doctor portrait. An operator directory publishes an absolute http(s) URL. The authored roster names a bundle-relative asset (`avatars/<doctor-id>.png`) that every client ships and resolves against its own asset root. Empty means no portrait and the UI shows the doctor's initial. Any other scheme (data:, javascript:, an absolute filesystem path, or a path that climbs out of the bundle) is dropped by every parser.
doctorProfile.verified: boolean; true only when the operator directory vouched for the clinician
doctorProfile.affiliations: DoctorAffiliation[] — at least one; person facts never include a hospital

portraits.artwork: apps/sdkwork-doctor-common/packages/sdkwork-doctor-common-doctor/assets/avatars/<doctor-id>.svg is the editable vector source; the canonical <doctor-id>.png beside it is the rendered portrait (RGBA, 256x256, transparent outside the circle).
portraits.generator: node tools/render-doctor-avatars.mjs renders every SVG headlessly and copies the PNG into each client bundle: apps/sdkwork-doctor-pc/public/avatars, apps/sdkwork-doctor-h5/public/avatars, apps/sdkwork-doctor-mini-program/src/assets/avatars, apps/sdkwork-doctor-flutter-mobile/assets/avatars.
portraits.rule: Every client ships byte-identical portrait bytes; tests/doctor-directory.test.mjs fails when one copy drifts. A portrait that fails to load falls back to the doctor's initial rather than to a broken image.

doctorAffiliation.hospitalCode: string, Appbase med_hospital natural key (required in a directory document; may be empty in the authored fallback)
doctorAffiliation.hospitalName: string, display snapshot of the site (required)
doctorAffiliation.hospitalGrade: string, e.g. THIRD_A; empty when not published
doctorAffiliation.departmentCode: string, Appbase med_department code; empty when not published
doctorAffiliation.department: string, localized department name at this site
doctorAffiliation.title: string, clinician rank at this site
doctorAffiliation.primary: boolean; exactly one affiliation is primary, or the first one is used
doctorAffiliation.since: YYYY-MM since when the engagement is active

employmentTypes.full_time: Exclusive full-time employment by the organization.
employmentTypes.part_time: Part-time engagement, typically limited sessions at this site.
employmentTypes.contract: Fixed-term contract engagement without a permanent post.
employmentTypes.visiting: Visiting / multi-site practice (多点执业): the clinician's primary post is elsewhere.

doctorConsultationChannel.target: URL, tel: link, or channel id; empty means the channel is unavailable

fallback.rule: used when careDoctorDirectoryUrl is empty, the request fails, or the document yields no valid clinician; demo organization ids and hospital codes, never real appointments

rules: selection is per doctor person, not per affiliation
the first selected doctor becomes the primary doctor
the primary doctor is always one of the selected doctors
removing the primary doctor promotes the next selected doctor
pruning drops selected ids that are no longer in the roster

consultation.rule: A human consultation chooses one affiliation (the primary one by default) and opens a conversation session addressed to that doctor in the conversation home, with the consultation reason as the patient's first turn; the visit record snapshots the doctor plus organizationId, hospital label, and employment type so the history stays accurate after the roster changes. The site's channels are displayed, not launched: the consultation itself happens in the conversation.

session.doctorReply: the attending doctor writes the reply on this device; the family sees it unread until the conversation is opened
session.unread: per-session read marks; the conversation list badges the assistant turns newer than the mark

noAppApi: This is a deployment document, not an SDKWork-owned app API surface: it uses no app-api path, no envelope code field is required, and no credentials are sent. Adding a first-party doctor service later must be proposed as an app-api change under API_SPEC.md before it replaces this contract.
